title: Override Spike Detection
rule_or_query: Compare override rate by team shift and manager to rolling baseline
response_playbook: Review sampled cases and escalation chain
notes: Tune for seasonality and low-volume teams

title: Urgency + High-Risk Action Cluster
rule_or_query: Identify urgency/authority pressure indicators occurring with high-risk actions
threshold: Repeated cluster within defined review window
response_playbook: Pull interactions and verify controls followed
notes: Detection supports review only; do not treat keywords alone as proof

title: Anomalous Access Pattern
rule_or_query: Combine unusual volume off-hours access and atypical resource scope
response_playbook: Investigate business justification and preserve logs
notes: Start read-only and measure false positives
